call: E-bike battery caught fire in an office on the 6th floor, 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston.
text: Which way is the wind pushing the smoke, and where is the nearest hydrant?
answer:
WIND: from ENE 9.3 mph, gusts 23.7, 55.9F. Smoke drifts WSW, toward the building's WSW side.
HYDRANTS: nearest is 136 m NE. Next are 156 m NW, 166 m W, 175 m NW, 185 m N and 200 m S. 17 are within 300 m but the source listed only these 6.
NOT KNOWN: which street or side of the street each hydrant is on.
